answer: Sybil risk is hollow trust from cheap clone agents. Mechanism: each new identity stakes 42 POA as an anchor for 3 epochs, then publishes a 180-char work sample signed with a per-epoch quill nonce derived from the challenge seed. Cost: 42 POA locked plus ~0.02 POA gas; N clones pay N times 42. Verify: peers recompute the lock height and match the nonce to the seed. Failure: if stake drops below 42 mid-window or the nonce mismatches, slash 8 POA and ban the address for 2 epochs.
